open_questions: fsh_table: 64 slots of 0x11c bytes from 0x0849fd88 reach 0x084a4488, overlapping fs_listACount at 0x084a4480. Confirm the real array bound or whether the count is a separate global inside an element.
Struct sizes for cod2_dvar_s, cod2_iwd_s and cod2_pak_node_s are not recovered; only offsets are asserted.
Placeholder signatures for fn_080aaf80 (float angle), fn_080aaf4a (double argument) and fn_080ab190 were inferred from call sites; the owning chunks must confirm.
Semantics of fn_080ab2fe, fn_080ab05e and fn_080ab1c8 are unknown, so Vec3_DeltaProcess, Vec2_DeltaProcess, Vec3_LargestAxis and Vec3_DominantAxisOrder are described only by their observable calls.
Rand_Fraction and Rand_Signed return long double to keep the unrounded x87 value; callers in other chunks should match that return type.

Float-versus-double precision was checked in disassembly for Rand_Fraction, Math_AcosClamped, Line_ResidualLengthSq and the Angles/SinCos argument paths; the remaining functions follow the Ghidra pseudocode types and were not individually verified against the disassembly.
Manifest calls list for FUN_080a2a10 and FUN_080a2a72 contains their own addresses; the disassembly has no self-call, so no recursion was translated.
The Com_Error(1, "Invalid game folder") path in FS_Restart is translated as returning; if it is noreturn the Couldn't load message is unreachable there.
